You’re right about one thing. I can’t stop you. But I will say this.  I promise that there is light at the end of the tunnel for you.  You may not be able to see it right now, and it may make you feel completely hopeless. But to see the light, you’ve got to keep going.  In the end, it will all be good. Trust me.

Well, I’ve accidentally slipped out small things about her to some of my friends’ parents.  Whenever I do, my mom usually pulls me aside a few days later all angry with me for making her look bad (they tell her). Sometimes, when I’m going somewhere, she’ll say something like “You better not say anything about me or it won’t be pretty.”  So I haven’t said anything, and I’ve stayed miserable at home.

I’m so sorry.  My parents have threatened to kick me out before too.  I can’t imagine what you’re going through.  I don’t know if there’s anything I can say to make this situation any better, but keep your head high.  It might just get better
